recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片中真皮被一片密集、瀰漫的單核細胞浸潤占滿，膠原纖維被細胞分隔，浸潤延伸至表皮下方；標題（ad 2）與分類無法指出確切診斷，需配合高倍與免疫染色判讀。
features: Dense, diffuse, monotonous cellular infiltrate replacing the entire dermis
Infiltrate dissects between collagen bundles in an interstitial pattern
Infiltrate extends up to the dermal-epidermal junction without an obvious grenz zone
Overlying epidermis intact and thin without ulceration
Individual cytology not resolvable at this low magnification
describe_en: Skin biopsy (H&E, low power) shows a dense, diffuse cellular infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the sampled dermis, dissecting between collagen bundles and extending up to the dermal-epidermal junction. The overlying epidermis is intact. Cytologic detail is not resolvable at this magnification, and the title and category do not specify a diagnosis. In a patient with acquired neutropenia, the pattern raises concern for a cutaneous hematolymphoid infiltrate such as leukemia cutis/myeloid sarcoma, which requires high-power review and immunohistochemistry (e.g., MPO, CD68, CD4, CD3, CD20) for classification.

ddx.vs: Shows immature myeloid or monocytic cells with fine chromatin that express MPO, lysozyme, CD68 or CD33 on immunohistochemistry.
Typically shows a grenz zone with CD20+ lymphoid cells, sometimes with follicular structures.
Spares the epidermis with a grenz zone and expresses CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 without MPO.
Shows papillary dermal edema with mature neutrophils and leukocytoclasia rather than a monotonous mononuclear infiltrate.
